candidates.change_summary: Replace check `msg.value >= MinDeposit` with `msg.value > MinDeposit` so deposit not added when exactly equal to MinDeposit.
Replace addition with subtraction in balance update: `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` → `balances[msg.sender]-=msg.value`.
Insert `balances[msg.sender] = 0;` before the existing balance update, so the balance is reset before addition.

Replace `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]));` with `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) > balances[msg.sender]));` so overflow revert cannot happen (but this changes condition to exclude zero-value deposit when balance is zero? Actually it only changes >= to >, so if msg.value==0 it would revert).
Delete the line `TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Deposit");` so deposit does not log; balance still changes.
